test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Rahul’s sister says that __my brother is the best dancer in the city__.

options.text: her brother is the best dancer in the city
my brother was the best dancer in the city
her brother was the best dancer in the city
his brother was the best dancer in the city

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the pronoun 'my' should be replaced with 'her' because Rahul's sister is referring to her own brother, not the speaker's brother.
 
• The sentence should maintain consistency in **pronouns to avoid confusion.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *Rahul’s sister says that her brother is the best dancer in the city*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pronouns should always be used in a way that clearly indicates the person or thing being referred to.
 
• Using the correct pronoun ensures the sentence is easily understood and avoids ambiguity.
